verdict.summary_en: Printed org chart (v1, dated 2026-09-01) of Soony Interactive GmbH's procurement organisation. The CPO and the Head of Procurement are at the top. Five roles report to the Head of Procurement, and three buyers sit below the category leads. The DC Hamburg site lead has a dotted line to the Head of Procurement. The Category Lead Collector's Items position is shown as TBD (vacant or unassigned) and is highlighted. The chart has no quantities, prices or approval decisions. Approval limits are not on this document and are referred to Approval Policy PP-07.
red_flags: The Category Lead Collector's Items position is shown as 'TBD' and highlighted. It is not filled, and Mei Lin (Buyer, Collector's Items) reports to this open position.
Approval limits are not stated here; they are in Approval Policy PP-07, which is not part of this document.
observations: Clean printed PDF, single page, with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The TBD box has a light orange fill, unlike the other boxes.
Henrik Dahl, Nils Berger and Clara Weiss appear only in the 'Also' footnote line, with no place in the reporting lines.
The Distribution Center Hamburg box is shown separately with a dotted-line relationship.
